scope.surface: Approved default public homepage palette and composition; Google Sans remains the shared default UI font
excludes: Custom homepage HTML, Markdown, and URL branches
scope.authority: User-approved production port of the pinned SiliconFlow composition in nerioncloud blue. Chrome remains the earlier Google Sans typography reference. Effective production CSS and approved captures are authority; no generated comp or seed applies to this refinement.
scope.review: .impeccable/review/production-home/review.md: disposition ship; all five sections reviewed; no material fixes
scope.fontCoverage: Self-hosted Google Sans has no CJK glyphs; Arial and system sans fallback remain essential. Explicit application font preferences are preserved.
scope.cssVariableNote: Homepage variables are scoped to .lf-home, so snippets provide literal production-value fallbacks for standalone shadow-DOM rendering.
scope.snippetNote: Static self-contained styling previews. Production interactions use shared React components, routing, accessibility and seven-language i18n. No homepage text-input or chip primitive exists; model selectors are shared Tabs. Optical preview shows geometry without reproducing observer-gated playback. The balance preview omits the existing decorative brand mark because panel snippets do not load external images.
scope.tonalRampNote: Synthesized OKLCH strips are preview metadata, not production palette additions. DESIGN.md frontmatter owns canonical colors.
scope.responsiveNavigation: Header is 72px desktop and 64px at 800px. At 500px and below, the toolbar action moves into the shared mobile menu. Hero remains left aligned with a 36px heading at 500px and below.
scope.motionGap: Shared AnimateInView covers entrance/reveal; LandingOpticalRibbon is required for heading anchoring, repeating CSS movement, offscreen/background/reduced-motion gating and cleanup.
scope.noPerformanceClaim: CSS owns curve shapes and translation; JavaScript follows layout and visibility. No quantified resource-performance claim is made.

narrative.overview:
nerioncloud pairs a clear Google Sans hierarchy with blue actions, alternating cool product fields, and one approved glass-ribbon image. The material gives the public homepage a recognizable focal point; semantic text and native controls carry the product explanation. The approved production composition follows the user's SiliconFlow reference. Chrome remains the earlier typography reference, rather than the current page-composition authority.

This records the default public homepage implemented in `web/src/features/home/components/landing-page.tsx` and its two local stylesheets. Its enterprise story connects model access, model choice, balance, and usage to registration. Google Sans also remains the shared default UI font, with explicit application font preferences preserved. Console and administration palettes, authentication layouts, and custom homepage HTML, Markdown, and URL branches retain their existing systems.
keyCharacteristics: Left-aligned, full-width hero with a right-biased glass ribbon and soft page-ground fades.
Alternating dark and light product cards with native model selectors and an illustrative console.
A working request/response demo, practical onboarding, and a compact dark closing band.
Two subtle heading-centered CSS curves, translated copy, keyboard access, dark surfaces, and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Local Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep homepage colors inside `.lf-home`; the console's shared theme remains its own source of truth.

rules.name: The Font Preference Rule
rules.body: Keep Google Sans as the shared default while preserving explicit user font choices, CJK fallback, and the monospace code face.

rules.name: The Motion Access Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion disables homepage animations and smooth scrolling, and makes header/button transitions effectively immediate; content and controls stay usable without movement.

dos: **Do** preserve the approved SiliconFlow-led homepage composition, nerioncloud blue identity, and Google Sans preference.
**Do** keep homepage colors local while retaining explicit application font preferences and CJK fallback.
**Do** reuse the shared header, footer, buttons, tabs, request path, and original interactive protocol demo.
**Do** retain seven-language copy, keyboard access, visible focus, dark surfaces, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** display the nerioncloud brand and preserve New API / QuantumNous / One API attribution and legal notices.
**Do** retain the approved hero raster and fades, plus the two heading-centered CSS curves with playback gates and cleanup.
donts: **Don't** add generated imagery beyond the approved ribbon asset or rasterize interactive content.
**Don't** present illustrative records, protocol metrics, catalog availability, or decorative currency as measured customer evidence.
**Don't** invent a sales destination or enable an unconfigured sales action.
**Don't** apply this homepage palette or composition to console themes, custom homepage branches, or authentication layouts.
**Don't** claim CJK coverage from the bundled Google Sans file or quantified runtime savings without measurement.
